versions.short: The bill would direct the Government Accountability Office to study federal efforts to protect commercial satellite systems from cyberattacks and report back to Congress within two years. It would require the Department of Commerce, working with the Department of Homeland Security, to create a free public online clearinghouse of cybersecurity guidance and tools for satellite operators, with extra materials for small businesses, and to gather voluntary security recommendations covering areas such as protection against jamming, hijacking, and foreign ownership or ground facilities. It would also require the Commerce Department to report periodically to Congress on this work and to deliver a federal coordination strategy for satellite cybersecurity within 120 days. The bill would not make satellite systems a formal critical infrastructure sector or create new regulations or licensing requirements.
